description: This file implements functions related to pruning packed objects in a Git-like repository, including progress display, file removal, and object checks.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Deletes directories if not in dry run mode, displaying progress during operation.

methods.name: int prune_object(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Removes a specific object file if it exists in the pack, or outputs a dry run command.

methods.name: void prune_packed_objects(int opts)
methods.description: Main function to prune packed objects in the repository, manages progress display and iterates over loose files.

ctags.name: prune_object
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_object(const struct object_id *oid, const char *path,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: prune_subdir
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr, const char *path, void *data)$/
